name: archflow-studio-web-openapi-ts
description: Isolated install of the hey-api generator. It lives apart from the web app because @hey-api/openapi-ts reads the TypeScript compiler's JS API (ts.SyntaxKind), which the Go-based TypeScript 7 the web builds with does not ship. This directory pins typescript@5 for the generator alone; nothing here is imported by the app.
